requirements.text: 4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer
Experience with Apache Airflow and Snowflake, or Python and SQL
Experience with AWS, GCP, or Microsoft Azure
Owns problems end-to-end: spots the issue in the data or pipeline, designs and builds the solution, and ships it to production
Shows business impact with concrete results such as faster data processing, lower infrastructure costs, fresher data, or fewer pipeline incidents
Advanced English for client calls, explaining technical decisions and presenting results
Works full-time remotely and delivers without supervision
Onboards quickly and starts shipping in the first weeks

resumes.text:
Name: Daniel Mercer
Summary: Senior data engineer with 8 years of commercial experience building batch and streaming pipelines for SaaS and retail companies. Strong background in cloud data platforms and in explaining technical trade-offs to business stakeholders.

Experience
Senior Data Engineer, Northwind Analytics (remote), March 2021 to present
- Built and operate Apache Airflow DAGs that orchestrate 140 daily jobs loading into Snowflake from ten source systems.
- Designed the Snowflake warehouse models used by finance and product teams, including slowly changing dimensions and a curated revenue layer.
- Deployed workloads on AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda) with infrastructure defined as code using Terraform.
- Noticed a silent drift in a vendor feed that had been corrupting attribution data for three weeks. Rebuilt the ingestion job, wrote the backfill, and shipped the fix to production the same week.
- Reworked the nightly refresh of the sales mart so it runs in 25 minutes instead of 3 hours, giving the sales team fresh numbers before their morning standup. Cut warehouse credit spend by about 30 percent in the same project.
- Present technical decisions, risks and results to client and executive stakeholders on regular calls, in advanced English.
- Work fully remote with no daily check-ins. I plan my own sprints and report progress asynchronously.

Data Engineer, Brightpath Retail, June 2018 to February 2021
- Built Python and SQL transformation jobs for point-of-sale data from 60 stores.
- Maintained scheduled pipelines and the on-call rotation for the data platform.

Education
B.Sc. Computer Science, University of Leeds, 2018

Skills
Apache Airflow, Snowflake, Python, SQL, dbt, AWS, Terraform, Kafka, English (advanced).

Name: Priya Nandakumar
Summary: Analyst turned data engineer with under two years in the engineering role and about four years in analytics. Hands-on with on-premise data warehousing, Python scripting and reporting automation, and keen to move into a cloud-based team.

Experience
Data Engineer, Halden Insurance (remote), March 2025 to present
- Maintain nightly ETL jobs that move policy and claims data from an on-premise Oracle Cloud Infrastructure database into the reporting warehouse.
- Wrote Python scripts and SQL stored procedures to reconcile claims totals against the general ledger each month.
- Diagnosed a nightly job failure caused by a schema change in the claims table. Patched the parsing logic, tested it against a staging copy, and deployed the fix to production the same afternoon.
- Rewrote a warehouse query used by the finance team so it finishes in 25 minutes instead of 3 hours, which let them close the monthly books a day earlier.
- I work full-time remotely and deliver my sprint tasks with minimal check-ins from the team lead.

Senior Analyst, Carrow and Finch Consulting, July 2021 to February 2025
- Prepared client reporting in Excel and SQL, and supported two migrations between reporting tools.
- Presented monthly results to small client teams in Hindi and conversational English.
- Ran weekly data quality checks on client extracts and kept a log of recurring issues so the team could fix root causes instead of patching reports by hand.
- Trained two interns on Excel pivot tables, naming conventions and basic reporting standards during their first month.

Education
Bachelor of Engineering (Information Systems), Pune Institute of Technology, 2021

Skills
Python, SQL, Oracle, Excel, ETL scripting, Linux, English (B1, conversational).

Name: Jordan Ellis
Summary: Marketing analyst with five years of experience measuring campaign performance for consumer brands. Known for clear dashboards and quick turnaround for non-technical teams. I have worked with agencies and in-house teams, and I am comfortable presenting numbers to people who do not read reports.

Experience
Marketing Analyst, Hollow Oak Media (fully remote), January 2022 to present
- Build weekly campaign dashboards in Google Sheets and Excel, tracking spend, reach and conversion for twelve client accounts.
- Maintain a shared spreadsheet model that forecasts quarterly ad budgets and flags accounts that are over pacing.
- Fully remote role: I manage my own calendar and deliverables and report to the marketing director on a weekly call.
- Built a lookup-driven template that cut the monthly reporting time per client from one day to about two hours.
- Ran a quarterly review with each client to agree on goals, test priorities and the reporting calendar for the next period.

Marketing Coordinator, Bluewater Hospitality, May 2019 to December 2021
- Coordinated email campaigns and social calendars for four restaurant brands.
- Produced monthly performance summaries for regional managers.
- Ran A/B tests on promotional emails and reported results to the brand team.
- Presented campaign results to store managers in short weekly briefings.
- Wrote the monthly newsletter and managed a small freelance design budget for seasonal menu launches.

Education
Bachelor of Arts in Communications, Reading University, 2019

Certifications
Google Analytics Certified Individual, 2021

Skills
Excel, Google Sheets, Google Analytics, Mailchimp, HubSpot, presentation design, stakeholder reporting, copywriting, budget tracking.
